flows.title: Create a survey from scratch
steps: Select Create survey from the SurveyMonkey header, on any screen.
Choose Start from scratch to get a blank survey page.
In the Build tab of Design Survey, add or edit questions, page elements and survey options directly in the survey preview.
Select Preview survey to test the respondent experience, then publish the survey to send it out.

flows.title: Share a survey by web link
steps: Go to the Publish survey section of the survey.
Select Add new collector +, then Share a link.
Choose the collector options. Optionally customize the web link, or edit the collector's nickname with the pencil icon.

flows.title: View individual responses
steps: Go to the Analyze Results section of the survey.
Click the Individual Responses tab toward the top of the page.
Switch between the Table and Single response views in the top right corner.
